test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - General Knowledge (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: gk
question: Which of these is NOT among the reforms related to agriculture undertaken under the five year plans?

options.text: Introduction of the policy of 'land to the tiller'
Introduction of the Land Ceiling Act
Launch of the high yielding variety seed technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Formation of Rent Authority Department**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Policy of 'land to the tiller':-**

 
 
• The policy of 'land to the tiller' was introduced under the first five year plan, which aimed at redistributing land from big landowners to landless farmers.
 
• The policy of 'land to the tiller' was aimed at reducing land inequality and improving the economic conditions of small and marginal farmers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Land Ceiling Act:-**

 
 
• The Land Ceiling Act was aimed at preventing the concentration of land in the hands of a few individuals and promoting equitable distribution of land.
 
• The Land Ceiling Act was also introduced under the first five year plan, which put a limit on the maximum amount of land that an individual could own.
 
 
 
• **High yielding variety seed:-**
 
 
• The high yielding variety seed technology was introduced under the third five year plan, which aimed at increasing agricultural productivity by introducing new and improved seed varieties.
 
• The high yielding variety seed technology was a major breakthrough in agricultural productivity, which helped India achieve self-sufficiency in food production.
 
 
 
• **Rent Authority Department:-**
 
 
• The Rent Authority Department was formed under the Rent Control Act, which aimed at regulating the rent charged by landlords and protecting the interests of tenants. However, it was not directly related to agricultural reforms.
 
• The Rent Authority Department was not among the reforms related to agriculture undertaken under the five year plans.
